title: Edge-case/reliability review of the Team Config 1-4 tooling itself (PR #61)
objective: PR #61 added five new opt-in reviewer roles, a shared gating helper, and a new deterministic mechanical check (PACKAGE_DENY_PATTERNS) to release-warden.js -- the single most security-relevant script in this repo's own tooling -- and merged to main without ever being independently reviewed by the graph it extends. This directive runs Team Configuration 1 (Failure Hunter + Reliability Reviewer) against that commit for real.
base_sha_note: Direct parent of candidate_sha -- single-commit candidate, matching the one-commit-per-candidate convention.
out_of_scope: packages/fw-agent and packages/fw-control source -- unchanged by this commit
re-reviewing MAINT-001/PENTEST-001's own findings about the firewall code -- this directive is about the review tooling itself, not what it already found
success_criteria: engineer receipt honestly documents this is a review-only pass of already-committed tooling
Failure Hunter systematically probes release-warden.js's new logic (evaluateOptionalVerdictReceipt, PACKAGE_DENY_PATTERNS, threat-model precondition ordering) against the general edge-case checklist
Reliability Reviewer independently reviews the nine dimensions against the same commit
